artifact.name: reference-scenes
artifact.purpose: The language-neutral demo content the reference applications load, so every platform refapp presents identical demo data (docs/ReferenceAppUX.md, 'Shared demo-scene artifact'). Keys are snake_case; congestion-level strings mirror the CanvasTrafficFlowCongestionLevel enum names.

camera_presets.label: Fixture center
camera_presets.note: The recorded golden camera: the Sacramento fixture neighborhood at its recorded zoom, north up, top down.

camera_presets.label: Route preview
camera_presets.note: Centers on the demo route polyline's bounding box at a tilted, bearing-rotated framing.

route.label: Route polyline
route.description: A three-point polyline entering bottom-left, bent through the viewport center (Capitol Park), and leaving upper-right (the native overlay golden's route scene).

polygon.label: Polygon fill
polygon.description: A rectangle ring spanning roughly the center third of the viewport (the native overlay golden's polygon scene).

markers.label: Point markers
markers.description: Three anchor positions spread diagonally across the viewport (the native overlay golden's marker scene).

traffic.label: Traffic flow
traffic.description: One segment per congestion level: free-flowing, slow, congested, and blocked (the native overlay golden's traffic scene, along the downtown L Street corridor).

simulated_trace.name: sacramento_clean_walk
simulated_trace.provenance: Recorded route geometry with deterministic synthetic fixes: the route is the provider-recorded pedestrian route Capitol Park -> Tower Bridge (the demo_routes member of this artifact, stitched at its shared step vertices), and the fixes are generated along it from a recorded seed by map-navigation's trace_fixture generator. No live GPS capture.

wasm_seam_status.reason: The Navigator is not exposed on the wasm seam yet; live simulated navigation arrives with the contract wave. Kotlin and Swift bind it today through the frozen UniFFI contract.

layout_preview.notice: Layout preview with fixed sample values from the demo trace's first recorded state. Illustrative and explicitly not live guidance.

active_maneuver.display_text: Turn right onto N St. Go for 970 m.

upcoming_maneuver.display_text: Turn left onto 2nd St. Go for 139 m.

deviation_alert_preview.text: Off route — 12.4 m from the route line; guidance is frozen until a graded fix recovers or a reroute applies.

demo_places.name: Capitol Park
demo_places.note: The recorded demo route's start, beside the State Capitol.

demo_places.name: Tower Bridge
demo_places.note: The recorded demo route's destination at the Sacramento River.

demo_places.name: Golden 1 Center
demo_places.note: The downtown arena at K and 5th.

demo_places.name: Sutter's Fort
demo_places.note: The 1839 fort and state historic park.

demo_plans.label: Clean walk
demo_plans.description: Replays a walk that follows the route start to finish; guidance runs clean.

demo_plans.label: Deviation recovery
demo_plans.description: Replays a walk that steps off the line and recovers; guidance freezes while off route.

demo_plans.label: Deviation reroute
demo_plans.description: Replays a walk that steps off the line; a replacement route is applied once the guidance freezes.
